name: pane-reader
description: A privacy-first local document reader extension for Chrome/Edge

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && vite build --config vite.config.mermaid.ts && vite build --config vite.config.background.ts
scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && vite build --watch --config vite.config.content.ts & vite build --watch
